provenance: Hand-curated at 320x240 using tools/labeltool.py and re-verified at 160x120 and 640x480. Four point labels mark left-block interior occlusion (ids 0/1 depth-order flips) and four mark right/middle precision pixels (single id, float32 vs float64 value drift). The boundary feature is labeled as an ROI rectangle because the shared-edge line shifts by a pixel column under integer re-gridding; the ROI asserts the boundary class occurs along that line at every resolution. All points avoid segment endpoints and frame borders.
